subject: Luminar Health — request for SLA remedy and remediation commitments
messages:
From: Alicia Ramos <alicia.ramos@luminarhealth.com>
To: hannah_schmitt@redwoodinference.com
Cc: platform@luminarhealth.com
Date: Sat, 5 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Production impact: sharp latency & 5xx spike — request for credits and remediation plan

Hannah —

We hit a pretty severe window this morning and are seeing two problems that have materially affected our customers: a sustained tail-latency increase (p95 from ~420ms to ~1.8s) and an elevated 5xx rate across inference endpoints between 02:13–05:42 PDT on 2027-06-05. Our ingest pipeline retried aggressively and the resulting backpressure caused downstream failures in our UI and notification system.

We need:
- A timeline and root-cause analysis for the incident
- A commercial remediation (credits/refund) for the impacted window — per the SLA we expect an objective calculation and proposed credit
- A short binding remediation plan (technical fixes + checkpoints) and an exec-level contact for escalation if we see regressions

I attached a small sample of logs (prod-logs-20270601.tar.gz) and a screenshot of 5xx trajectories. We are already pausing a subset of calls to mitigate customer impact, but this is a production outage for us.

Please escalate to the appropriate folks at Redwood and propose a commercial offer by EOD Monday PST. We can schedule an exec call with our Head of Platform (cc’d) if helpful.

—Alicia
Alicia Ramos
Head of Platform Engineering, Luminar Health
A: +1 (415) 555-0189

[Attachment: prod-logs-20270601.tar.gz]

Date: Sat, 5 Jun 2027 09:28:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Production impact: sharp latency & 5xx spike — request for credits and remediation plan

Team — forwarding Luminar’s note. Short summary: 3.3 hour production impact window, large p95 tail increase and elevated 5xx. They want an SLA calculation + proposed credit and a binding remediation plan with exec contact.

Immediate asks:
- Ben: commercial proposal (credits + one-time concession) and negotiation strategy. Can you model a fair offer (percent credit vs dollar value) and recommended approval path?
- Jonas: please compile the account activity (usage tier, committed spend, recent burst patterns) and confirm current contract terms (SLA language + amendment constraints).
- Marissa (Support): please triage logs Alicia attached and pull runtime metrics for the impacted timeslice. Attach sla-impact-calculation.xlsx when ready.

I’d like a proposed response by EOD Monday PST so we can surface to legal/CRO ASAP. If this looks like a broader systemic issue, escalate to infra OG.

Thanks — Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Senior Manager, Customer Success — Redwood Inference
hannah_schmitt@redwoodinference.com
[Internal note: priority-high]

From: ben_carter@redwoodinference.com
To: hannah_schmitt@redwoodinference.com, jonas_weber@redwoodinference.com
Cc: marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com
Date: Sat, 5 Jun 2027 11:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Production impact: sharp latency & 5xx spike — request for credits and remediation plan

Thanks Hannah — I pulled their contract and usage. Quick thoughts:
1) SLA math: their tier entitles them to 99.9% availability; outage window ~3.5h across a 30-day billing period equals ~0.5% of month — headline credit calculation suggests a 15–25% pro-rated credit for the impacted month depending on whether we use gross uptime or per-endpoint metrics. I’ll attach a worked sheet (sla-impact-calculation.xlsx).
2) Commercial posture: propose a two-part offer: (a) a pro-rated credit for the month equal to 20% of monthly platform fees for impacted nodes; (b) a one-time goodwill credit of $15k to cover immediate customer remediation costs and to signal urgency.
3) Binding remediation: offer a 90-day remediation & monitoring package with weekly checkpoints + a named escalation lead (CTO on-call + our Platform Ops lead). If they insist on a stronger SLA we can offer a contract amendment via DocuSign but push legal review.

Approval path: require sales lead + CRO approval for the $15k and any amendment to SLA language. If leadership agrees to the 20% + $15k, we can route an amendment doc and DocuSign by Tuesday.

Marissa — can you confirm whether the incident is isolated to a single deployment (region) or if we saw cross-region kernel failures? If it’s isolated we can frame the offer more narrowly.

—Ben
Ben Carter
Director, Sales — Redwood Inference
[Attachment: sla-impact-calculation.xlsx]

From: Alicia Ramos <alicia.ramos@luminarhealth.com>
To: hannah_schmitt@redwoodinference.com, ben_carter@redwoodinference.com
Cc: platform@luminarhealth.com
Date: Mon, 7 Jun 2027 08:19:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood response — initial remediation and commercial ask

Thanks for the quick turnaround. A few clarifications and counterpoints:

1) Luminar prefers a binding amendment to the contract that calls out (i) a remediation timeline with weekly checkpoints, (ii) a commercially enforceable credit schedule, and (iii) an escalation path with named contacts.
2) We appreciate the proposed 20% + $15k goodwill but after quantifying downstream impact we are asking for 30% pro-rated credit for the impacted month. Our downstream revenue leakage estimate is material and we need a firm remediation cadence.

We’re happy to join an exec call this week to resolve quickly. Please attach the draft amendment (we prefer DocuSign) and a remediation runbook. We’ve attached an expanded error-sample in the support thread (not included here).

—Alicia

Folks — quick status update before we loop execs:

- Luminar is pushing for 30% pro-rated credit and a signed amendment. They want weekly checkpoints for 90 days and a named escalation contact.
- Ben’s 20% + $15k is where sales/legal typically land quickly; the delta is the additional 10% they're asking for.
- Marissa confirms this looks scoped to a single region (us-west) and our infra team has a patch candidate to reduce tail latency (rolling kernel update + KV cache tuning). We can commit to a 7-day remediation runway to validate change in staging and can propose weekly status reports.

Proposed next steps:
1) Approve a negotiating ceiling: I recommend we authorize up to 25% pro-rated credit and keep the $15k goodwill credit. Anything above 25% needs CRO signoff.
2) Prepare a short amendment draft (redwood-amendment-draft-v1.docx) that includes SLA credit table and 90-day remediation cadence. Legal — please check language and prepare DocuSign envelope.
3) Schedule an exec call (Luminar execs + our CRO + Head of Platform + Ops lead) — propose Wed 09:00 PDT.

I’ll draft the customer-facing email and attach the amendment. If everyone agrees with the 25% ceiling we’ll respond to Luminar and confirm the Wednesday call.

—Hannah
